projects.title: Cedar Lake Carpentry
projects.description: Designed and developed a high-end marketing website for a luxury carpentry business to strengthen brand credibility and drive inbound client inquiries. Built a fully responsive Next.js application featuring a custom project gallery, service-focused content architecture, and a streamlined contact/quote form. Optimized for performance and SEO, resulting in a professional digital presence aligned with premium home builders.
highlights: Luxury UI aligned with premium builder clientele

projects.title: Rentulator
projects.description: Built a full-stack Airbnb investment analysis tool that calculates cash flow, ROI, and key financial metrics to help users evaluate rental property opportunities. Implemented a multi-step form experience, real-time financial calculations, and a responsive dashboard UI using Next.js and TypeScript. Designed with a focus on usability and product thinking, including mobile optimization and PWA support for installable app functionality.
highlights: Real-time ROI and cash flow calculations
PWA support for installable app experience

projects.title: Ideal Mobile Detailing
projects.description: Developed a modern service-based website for a mobile detailing business to improve customer acquisition and showcase services. Built with Next.js and Tailwind, featuring a clean UX, service breakdowns, and a visual gallery to highlight past work. Focused on conversion-driven design and performance, with a scalable foundation for future features such as online booking and customer accounts.
highlights: Responsive gallery to showcase completed work
Clean, modern UI built for customer trust
Scalable foundation for booking and user features
